title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #050 · 광택 소재 믹스 · 세로 띠·매끈 · 5영역(에메랄드 에나멜+티타늄 무지개+구리박+코발트 에나멜+루비 에나멜) · 풀커버 · hourglass bombshell · 와이드 스탠스 · Chinese · 배경 협곡 · 데코라
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail lavender hair — her body is covered in 5 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 vertical bands by 4 hazy transition zones centred about 9% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 21% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 46% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 92% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries emerald-green high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries anodised titanium in iridescent blue, violet and gold bands, a metallic oxide shimmer. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied copper leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright warm copper sheen. Region 4 is the strip between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 5 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries deep ruby-red high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy bronze leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in bronze lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a sunlit red-rock canyon floor with a smooth sandy path, low boulders of knee height and a waist-high wooden trail rail, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
